verses.1: To be destroyed by the skilled musicians of David.
verses.2: Hear my prayers, O God! Do not ignore my supplications.
verses.3: Listen to me and answer my questions. I will speak with you in my words, and I will do so in a way that is pleasing to you.
verses.4: From the sound of their cries, I am terrified at the sight of the wicked. They lay traps for me, and they humble me in their attacks.
verses.5: My heart is filled with fear, and death’s fears have fallen upon me.
verses.6: Fear and trembling will come over me; darkness will cover me.
verses.7: And he said, “Who will give me a dove to fly away and bring me news?”
verses.8: Look, they have gone far away to the desert.
verses.9: She hid me from the wind of S’a’ar.
verses.10: In the valley of Adonai, there are many people who fight with each other. For I saw chaos and strife in the city.
verses.11: Day and night, they suffer under their hardships; they endure sorrow and toil.
verses.12: They are close to her, but not far from her. They are both inside and outside of her.
verses.13: For he will not harm me, nor will he despise me. He will increase my strength and give me courage from within.
verses.14: And you are a man who is wise and knowledgeable.
verses.15: When they walk together in the house of God, they walk with joy.
verses.16: May death fall upon them! May the living creatures descend upon them, as if they were trapped in their own homes.
verses.17: I will cry out to God, and Jehovah will save me.
verses.18: In the evening, at noon, and in the morning, I will sacrifice. I will make offerings. They will hear my voice.
verses.19: May my soul be freed from distress, for there were many who stood against me.
verses.20: He will hear, and he will answer them. He will sit at the head of the throne, and there will be no one who can replace him. And they will not fear the Lord.
verses.21: He stretched out his hands in his hands, breaking his covenant.
verses.22: They divided the warmth of his words and brought them close to his heart. His words were like incense, and they opened up doors for him.
verses.23: Be angry with Yahweh, but He will still bless you. He will not allow you to be lost forever in sin.
verses.24: And you, God, bring them to understand that deceit and hypocrisy will not last forever. I promise you this.
